_unit: One case = one camera frame. Positive = the frame shows at least one worker without a safety vest.
_base_rate: Share of frames in production that really contain a worker without a vest (0-1).
_cost_fn: EUR when a violation passes unnoticed (missed).
_cost_fp: EUR when an alert fires on a frame with no violation (false alarm).
_cost_tp: EUR spent acting on a real violation that was caught (0 if you treat it as free).
_cost_tn: EUR for a clean frame correctly passed (usually 0).
_review_seconds: Seconds a person needs to check one frame.
_reviewer_cost_per_hour: EUR per hour for the person reviewing frames.
_cases_per_day: Frames the system judges per day.
_reviewer_hours_per_day: Hours one reviewer can spend reviewing per day.
